note: Captured once from the published effect-dynamodb@1.40.0 and @effect-dynamodb/schema@1.40.0, installed outside the repo and run by a scratch script against DynamoDB Local. The model holds structs that rename their keys on encode (Schema.encodeKeys): meta { amount -> am, tags -> tg, note }, swap { a -> b, b -> a }, outer (stored as ot) { inner -> in: { deep -> dp }, list: [{ deep -> dp }] }, maybe (optional, nullable meta), recs (a record of { deep -> dp }), either (meta or a struct holding amount as amount), counts (a sparse map, prefix c, of { deep -> dp }), and defaulted, a struct { amount?: number } decoded to { amount: number } by a transformation that defaults amount to 0 (no key rename). Entities Plain and Retained (versioned: { retain: true }), each seeded by put. For each path spelled by stored names and by domain names, as a path operation (alone on each entity, and on Plain in a transaction), a condition, a filter and a select: its outcome, every request it sent, whole and in order (GetItem and Query included), the row after it and what get read back; the table's name is replaced by <table>, UUIDs and timestamps by <token> and <time>. Never regenerate it: it is the record of what 1.40.0 did.
